title: Berlin Market Halls - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin built 14 covered market halls** between 1886 and 1892, numbered I to XIV in the order they opened.
**Four still sell food:** Markthalle Neun (IX), Arminiusmarkthalle (X), Marheineke (XI) and the Ackerhalle (VI), which is now a supermarket.
**All four are closed on Sundays and public holidays,** apart from a few special markets at Markthalle Neun.
**Markthalle Neun is best on Thursday from 17:00** for Street Food Thursday, or on Saturday for the big market.
**The Arminiusmarkthalle in Moabit** is the calmer choice, with kitchens open from noon to 22:00.
**Doors open is not the same as stalls open:** most stalls trade from late morning to 18:00 or 20:00.
**Pick your day and time in the tool** to see which hall is worth the trip and line up two of them.
